data.name: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
data.headline: Hungover? Same. 1 month unlimited, flat ₹15,000. 57 hours only.
data.benefit: Hungover? Same. For the next 57 hours, 1 Month Unlimited is a flat ₹15,000 (Bengaluru: ₹10,000). Only 57 memberships per city, then it disappears faster than your NYE plans. Start any day before 15 Jan.
data.rationale: January is the strongest non-April month in Mumbai (Jan-26: Kwality ₹27.4L, Bandra ₹20.0L; Kenkere ₹11.1L). A capped spot price creates urgency without training clients to wait — only 57 units per city, so the maximum discount exposure is ~₹3.0L in Mumbai and ~₹2.6L in Bengaluru.
data.audience: Everyone, while the capped stock lasts; one per person.
data.conditions: Spot offer, so the >25% cap does not apply. Replaces (does not stack with) the 15% newcomer or lapsed perk. Active members may buy it as their next renewal only if their plan ends before 31 Jan.
data.kpi: Sell-out time; share of spot buyers renewing in Feb at standard price (target 55%).

scenes.title: Third Time's the Charm
scenes.narration: New clients: Third Time's the Charm. First class: awkward. 12 buyers at 12,406 rupees — 1.49 lakh rupees. 33 per cent off.

data.name: Third Time's the Charm
data.headline: First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.
data.benefit: First class: awkward. Second class: better. Third class: you're hooked. Try barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab — 3 classes for the price of 2 (₹3,885). Bengaluru: 3 barre classes for ₹2,835. Love it? Your first membership is 15% off.
data.rationale: 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.
data.conditions: One per person (phone verified). Intro products sit outside the 25% cap as acquisition cost. Class 2 booked at the desk before leaving class 1.
data.kpi: Packs with all 3 classes used in 14 days (target 60%); pack → membership (target 35% vs 20.8% on 2-for-1).

data.name: U Up? It's 2027.
data.headline: U up? Your mat's been asking about you.
data.benefit: U up? Your mat's been asking about you. Come back this January: 15% off, and hit 12 classes this month for 5 bonus days. No awkward small talk, promise.
data.rationale: Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
data.audience: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)
data.conditions: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned). No stacking with the spot sale.
data.kpi: Lapsed buyers; share hitting 12 classes (target 40%); Feb renewal of Jan winbacks.

data.name: The Baker's Dozen
data.headline: 12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual and get 13.
data.benefit: 12 months is so 2026. Renew your annual this January and we'll bake in a 13th month — plus your 2 privates, 4 guest passes, a hosted class and monthly trainer check-ins. A baker's dozen hits different.
data.rationale: Annual is Kwality's #1 product (32 units, ₹51.6L in the last 12 months) and Bandra's #3 (15 units, ₹23.8L). The ANN-2026-25%-KH code gave away ₹9.7L at a flat 25%; this gives less cash away (≈21.5% effective) and adds time, which costs little at spare capacity.
data.conditions: ≈21.5% effective (annual cap 25%). Annual, 6M and 3M members expiring 1 Dec–28 Feb.
